name: Rangpur District Police — SP office and thanas
attribution: Office of the Superintendent of Police, Rangpur (police.rangpur.gov.bd) and the thana portals
notes: No licence stated. police.rangpur.gov.bd publishes no contact table; SP office from the Superintendent's officer card, thanas from each thana's portal officer cards (office landline, OC's police official mobile, *.gov.bd e-mail). Personal e-mails, other mobiles and officers' names are not copied. The 'এক নজরে' page gives 8 thanas; only the 7 upazila thana portals were found (police.rangpursadar.rangpur.gov.bd is the old Kotwali thana, now RpMP).
